Subject: Re: GCP private offer — commit sizing & drawdown schedule (DataFoundry)

Liam —

Perfect, thanks for the numbers. Looping in Marissa (Marketplace partnerships) and Ben (billing) to confirm partner routing and the invoice cadence. Below is a proposed drawdown schedule that aligns with the $450k commit:

- Months 1–3: $60k/month (ramp period; credits applied to Dedicated pool first)
- Months 4–9: $40k/month
- Months 10–12: $30k/month (end-of-term buffer to avoid unused commit)

Rationale: front-loaded acceleration to support your Q3 launch, then steady-state to match forecast. We can flip the cadence to quarterly if procurement prefers fewer invoices.

On your questions:
- Partner routing: listing CloudBridge on the private offer is sufficient for billing routebacks in most GCP private offer flows; if you need them to be a reseller on the Marketplace listing we can coordinate that, but it usually adds a 2–3 week ops delay. I'll let Marissa confirm the recommended path.
- SLA addendum: we have a standard SLA addendum and an enterprise SLO clause for Dedicated pools. Ben, can you attach the SLA addendum and confirm invoice language we should ask procurement to include?

Next steps:
1) Ben to confirm invoice wording and attach SLA addendum.
2) Marissa to confirm partner routing and whether we should set CloudBridge as reseller.
3) If agreed, Jordan will prepare the final private offer and send DocuSign link.

Attached: RWI-DF-commit_schedule.xlsx (proposed cadence)

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks — cc'ing Marketplace ops and billing. Short answers and suggested path:

- Invoice wording: please have procurement include the offer reference (RWI-DF-2026-POFFER-01) and the GCP marketplace private-offer billing clause: "Charges will be processed via GCP Marketplace private offer and remitted to Redwood Inference as specified." Ben, see suggested invoice footer below.

Suggested invoice footer (billing team):
"This invoice references GCP Marketplace private offer RWI-DF-2026-POFFER-01. Charges are billable under DataFoundry's GCP commit and remitted to Redwood Inference per the private offer terms."

- SLA addendum: attached SOW + standard SLA addendum (light redlines applied for Dedicated pools).
- Co-sell: we can schedule a 30-minute co-sell kickoff with CloudBridge and your GTM ops next week to align demand-gen assets and a webinar.

I attached SOW_DataFoundry_v1.2.docx and the marketplace checklist. If this looks good, we'll prepare the DocuSign wrapper and final private offer entry in the GCP console.
